Crypto Lab: an experiment app for sending data to another phone over an encrypted channel
(Wi-Fi or Bluetooth, paired by QR code or a 6-digit code). It is not Passkey Vault.
Marked as a pre-release on purpose, so Passkey Vault's updater ignores it.

Install the APK on two Android 14+ phones; see cryptolab/README.md for how to try it.


## What's Changed
* Crypto Lab: release workflow like the demo's by @aman-dhakar-191 in https://github.com/aman-dhakar-191/passkey-provider-android/pull/55


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/aman-dhakar-191/passkey-provider-android/compare/demo-v1.0.3...cryptolab-v0.1.0

Passkey Demo: a test app for trying passkeys the way other apps use them. It is not Passkey Vault.
Marked as a pre-release on purpose, so Passkey Vault's updater ignores it.

`assetlinks.json` is the file the demo's site must publish at `/.well-known/assetlinks.json`.

store.notes:
The store no longer runs into GitHub's rate limit: it reads one release index instead of asking GitHub once per app, and keeps the last list when a refresh fails. Tap an app to open its page, with full release notes and a fresh check of just that app.
